translations.web: Though you mount on high as the eagle, and though your nest is set among the stars, I will bring you down from there,” says Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Though you soar like the eagle and make your nest among the stars, even from there I will bring you down,” declares the LORD.
translations.kjv: Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle, and though thou set thy nest among the stars, thence will I bring thee down, saith the LORD.
translations.asv: Though thou mount on high as the eagle, and though thy nest be set among the stars, I will bring thee down from thence, saith Jehovah.
